title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S10 E08 — International: France
Pete travels through France with tree house visionary Alain Laurens; winding through the magical countryside, Alain shows Pete his structures that implement ingenious engineering, reach dizzying heights, and redefine what a tree house can be.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S11 E01 — Hawaiian Island Treehouse Adventure
Pete journeys to Kauai to build a sky-wave tree house for a couple who ditched the mainland for a laid-back lifestyle; he transforms a bohemian tree house for two former professional surfers into a masterpiece with a crow's nest 60 feet above ground.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S10 E07 — Mountainside Bulldog Bungalow
A dog-loving couple dream of a tree house that recaptures mountain vistas; Pete and his team build a bulldog bungalow that offers a bounty of outdoor decks and loads of large windows to take in a view once lost.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S10 E05 — Treehouse Utopia
Pete partners up in Utopia, Texas, for his first joint venture: a tree house bed-and-breakfast built for romance; a French-inspired chapel of love has a 25-foot steeple and the biggest bathroom Pete has built to date.

title: Gator Boys
description:
S01 E01 — Alligator Rampage
Paul and Jimmy argue over Jimmy's goal to expand the Gator Boys Rescue Operation; Jimmy disappears; Paul tries to keep the Gator Boys from falling apart.

title: Gator Boys
description:
S01 E03 — Mama Gator Mayhem
Paul and Jimmy capture a monster-sized gator; an alligator fights to protect her young.

title: Hard Truths of Conservation
description:
S04 E05 — The Bear
The brown bear is one of North America's most formidable predators; Dan Cabela travels to Kodiak Island to meet the research team participating in a scientific collaring program aimed at better understanding predator-prey interactions.

title: Nature's Strangest Mysteries: Solved
description:
S01 E16 — Scorpion Night Lights
A look at why a leopard let its dinner escape; an ominous dark mass looming over an Icelandic lake; some scorpions glow in the dark.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S03 E03 — Doctor Dads
Dr. Blue castrates five adult bulls on a vegan cattle ranch; a scary bulldozing occurs; a hen with a rough-mating injury; a young puppy is hit by a car.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S03 E07 — Fly, Miss Thang, Fly
Dr. Ross examines a barred owl that was hit by a car, but he hopes will fly again; the doctors also visit an animal rescue center and get close to Texas wildlife.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S03 E05 — Dr. Blue Gets Tanked
Dr. Blue wants a home aquarium; Dr. Ross attempts to diagnose a dog with bizarre test results; Dr. Lavigne performs knee surgery on a bulldog; a lamb has breathing problems.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S03 E06 — Bait n' Switch
Six sugar gliders turn Dr. Ross into their personal jungle gym; a young Chihuahua with atypical heart trouble; the doctors fish with a client.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S03 E01 — Hurricane Harvey Special
Dr. Blue opens up the clinic after Hurricane Harvey pours 30-plus inches of rain on the city of Houston, Texas; the doctors help animals affected by the storm, while dealing with the personal issues that Hurricane Harvey has brought to the city.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S04 E01 — The Pig Whisperers
A pit bull suffers a raccoon attack; an aggressive ferret; the vets test their pig-whispering skills at an animal rescue; the doctors have a surprise announcement for their wives.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S01 E09 — Miracle Cat
Kidney disease plagues an overweight cat; dog gets hit by a car while the owners are overseas.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:

A golden retriever with a broken leg is rushed into the clinic by his devastated owner; Dr. Jeff and his team treat a beagle after a vicious dog attack.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:

A cat with a shattered paw needs help; a rescued opossum needs a new enclosure; in South Dakota, a badly injured dog steals Jeff's heart.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet

title: North Woods Law
description:
S04 E08 — Outfoxed
The wardens are on full alert as the tourist season begins; crowded campground is being terrorized by a fox; rowdy partygoer gets a little irresponsible on an ATV.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S04 E11 — Distress Call
The warden's responsibilities change with the season; Sgt. Spahr helps a wounded owl, while Warden Stevens leads a team on a night rescue mission to find a distressed hiker.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S04 E07 — Man VS. Animal
The animals all come out of the woodwork at the start of spring; a routine littering summons morphs into a rabid pit-bull encounter; new evidence emerges with the spring thaw on an old deer-poaching case.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S04 E14 — Star Spangled Weekend
People are out to celebrate the Fourth of July; a group of teenagers vandalizes private property during a bonfire.

title: North Woods Law
description:

High-speed chase ensues on an ATV trail when the wardens hunt down a man with an outstanding warrant; warm weather brings blatant law violators and repeat offenders.

title: North Woods Law
description:

Sgt. Hawks and Officer Benvenuti supervise Trainee Frye's lobster trap detail; Officer Lucas and Trainee McDermott deal with a woman illegally keeping a wild squirrel; Officer Delisle and Biologist Marchand investigate the deaths of multiple turtles.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S11 E10 — Fatal Attraction
Lt. Bill Boudreau investigates a complaint about a man illegally feeding bears; Officer Jon Demler pulls over a swerving car, only to find himself in the middle of a domestic dispute; the dive team searches for a man who may have drowned in Kingston.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S05 E02 — What is This Kid Doing?
When the openings of both the bighorn sheep and archery elk hunting seasons overlap, wardens catch illegal hunters in the act; off-roaders cause some serious land damage; on the 4th of July seemingly intoxicated boaters give wardens a difficult time.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S04 E04 — I Didn't Shoot That Elk
Wardens monitor hunters who try to start the big game hunting season early; a landowner chooses to press charges against a trespassing hunter; the warden catches a hunter lying, with ballistics evidence to back it up.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S05 E01 — The Hunt of a Lifetime
A warden follows the trail to locate a mysterious group of hunters; when a warden draws a coveted mule deer hunting tag, he makes memories to last a lifetime; wardens have to ask some tough questions when a large pile of wasted game birds is found.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S04 E01 — Going to Jail in a Bikini?
Wardens find that a group of litterbugs is guilty of even more violations, and the Sheriff's office has to be called in; Wardens catch over-the-limit anglers in the act.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S04 E03 — Life Jackets Work Better When Worn
The annual Boat Float has wardens hustling to clear rivers of capsized rafters; young anglers may not be telling the truth about having fishing licenses; a father and son are caught red-handed.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S04 E08 — Unanswered Questions
Wardens investigate the story of a veterinarian who claims he killed a bear out of season but in self-defense; the waterfowl season opener brings out the hunters in full force and a warden goes undercover to find illegal activity.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S04 E02 — Pull 'um Over
Wardens track down out-of-state hunters not abiding by the law, and the illegally harvested elk may end up getting confiscated; Wardens get the word out to snowmobilers about required permits.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S04 E05 — Officer Caution - She is Signal 90
An intoxicated woman surprises a warden when she reveals she's pregnant, then friends have to come pick her up and drive her car home.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:

Wardens crack down on illegal hunters of shed elk antlers; wardens Schwalm and Holland go out on the game range to look for signs of poachers; wardens assist with walleye spawning.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S08 E05 — Knife's Edge
A New Hampshire family comes a long way to find a new dog; call leads to a heartbreaking find; Earl finally sees a spine specialist.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S07 E06 — From Darkness to Dawn
Tia takes a new rescue to the vet and receives heart-wrenching news; community rallies to raise funds for Earl's surgery; Mariah must conquer her greatest fear when an adopter with a unique challenge arrives.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S07 E04 — Saving Each Other
Heart-breaking plea is made by veteran to help be reunited with his dogs; overwhelmed shelter needs Tia's help; former volunteer returns.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S07 E09 — Hero's Journey
Adopter comes to VRC hoping to fill the void in her heart after her dog passes away; Louise and Matt rescue a hit-and-run dog; the dog Tia brings with her when she appears on "The Daily Show With Jon Stewart" gets sick.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S07 E01 — Above and Beyond
Tia gets a phone call about an emaciated pit bull, which turns out to be one of the worst cases she has ever seen; Earl attempts to convince the NY State authorities that a prison dog program is in their best interest.

title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
description:
S02 E04 — Big Day for Baby Rhino
Terri helps prepare the zoo's new baby rhino, Carrie, to receive a lifesaving vaccine; Robert is on a rescue mission to save two black swans in very bad shape; Bindi tries to determine if a cranky wombat named Poa might be pregnant.

title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
description:
S02 E02 — Robert's Python Swim
Robert gets in the water with Gloria, a 12-foot reticulated python, to swim alongside her for the first time in the Crocoseum; Bindi welcomes home two orphaned kangaroo joeys; Terri helps release a rescued wedge-tailed eagle back into the wild.

title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
description:
S02 E03 — Road Trip Rescue
Carrying three baby kangaroos and an emu, the Irwins caravan into the Australian Outback to release the animals on Mourachan, their giant wildlife conservation property; plans shift when they discover more animals in need of rescue along the way.

title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
description:
S02 E11 — Robert & the Rattlesnakes
Robert wrangles western diamondback rattlesnakes in Arizona for the first time, learning techniques passed down by his dad; Terri helps save some of the hospital's tiniest patients, three baby feathertail gliders; Bindi chats with Occa the cockatoo.

title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
description:
S02 E05 — Crocodile Love Story
It's moving day for Acco, the zoo's biggest crocodile; all goes to plan until his mate Cassie goes into hiding; the team races to reunite the bonded pair in their new enclosure; the rescue unit fights to save a flying fox entangled in barbed wire.

description:
S03 E07 — Hunt in the Clouds
Atz Sr., Atz Lee and Jane hunt for a wild goat; Eivin and Eve's bee hive and honey harvest are destroyed by a wasp infestation; Otto and Charlotte are determined to protect the hay crop.

title: Alaska: The Last Frontier
description:

Several animals are stuck with porcupine quills; Atz and his family move an abandoned cabin; Eve's garden is decimated.

Atz and Atz Lee swim their horses across a lake; Eivin hunts clams; Eve collects wild mushrooms; Otto and Charlotte bury a friend.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E01 — Monster Crabber
Deep in the woods and bayous of Louisiana, wildlife agents protect the state's resources; a crab fisherman is caught stealing dozens of traps, a hunter crosses state lines with an illegal deer and agents rescue an injured bald eagle.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E05 — Blind Rage
As a storm rolls in over St. Tammany Parish, Cpl. Blaine Wagner and Cpl. Rick Clark assist in a search-and-rescue mission for a missing fisherman; agents confront a repeat offender for harassing hunters, and a felon is caught with an illegal firearm.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E04 — Spy in the Sky
While using the LDWF's spy in the sky drone, agents track down a boat captain breaking the law in Plaquemines Parish; a family of shrimpers is investigated for pulling oversized nets; two feuding fishermen are suspected of being under the influence.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E02 — Road Killer
In Jackson Parish, a reckless hunter is investigated for shooting down a highway; agents stake out a man suspected of two illegal deer kills; duck hunters are confronted for harassment; a crowded boat parade ends with citations.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E06 — Deer in the Headlights
In Ouachita Parish, a trespassing investigation leads to a dicey encounter and multiple seizures of deer; agents confront a group of duck hunters who are spotted killing non-game birds; health code violations are found during a routine oyster patrol.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E03 — Mr. Bad Guy
In southern Louisiana, Lt. David Nunez and Sgt. Austin Arteaga investigate a group of bird hunters on opening day of teal season; a repeated offender is busted for taking immature crabs; a late-night deer decoy leads to a hunter in handcuffs.
